# REVIEW-NNN: Change name

- Spec / plan:
- Author:
- Independent reviewer:
- Commit/revision reviewed:
- Date:
- Verdict: Approve | Approve after fixes | Block

## Verification performed

Record commands and observable results. Do not claim checks that were not run.

## Findings

| ID  | Severity | Evidence (file:line/test) | Impact | Required fix | Owner | Disposition | Verification |
| --- | -------- | ------------------------- | ------ | ------------ | ----- | ----------- | ------------ |

Severity: Blocker, High, Medium, Low. `Disposition` is fixed, accepted with rationale,
or rejected with evidence. Blocker/high cannot be accepted for a normal release.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and scope
- [ ] API compatibility and validation
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, secrets, and privacy
- [ ] Transactions, constraints, concurrency, and idempotency
- [ ] External failure/retry behavior
- [ ] Tests would fail before the fix
- [ ] Logging, metrics, health, deploy, and rollback
- [ ] Docs, OpenAPI, migrations, and locale files

## Residual risk and follow-up
